twoBedroomSaleBaseline.sourceCheck: Direct detail page confirms exact project, 2 beds, 47 sqm, ฿1,750,000; project page refreshed listing 2026-10-17.

yieldEstimate.rentRateFallback: The only currently recent rent listing is one-bedroom; its per-sqm rate is used as a clearly linked fallback for the two-bedroom purchase baseline because PropertyHub and Hipflat have no recent exact two-bedroom rental sample.

notes: The two other Hipflat rent listings show last updated 2026-09-09 and were not included in current sample statistics.
PropertyHub exact-project rental page states no matched rental properties.
The yield is an estimate with a one-bedroom market rent-rate proxy; a verified two-bedroom rental listing is still needed to produce a same-room-type yield.
